learning_goals: Define the six trigonometric ratios (sine, cosine, tangent, cosecant, secant, cotangent).
Calculate all trigonometric ratios for a given angle in a right-angled triangle.

Understand and verify trigonometric identities.

sections.title: Introducing the Six Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Define sine, cosine, and tangent in the context of a right-angled triangle.
Identify the opposite, adjacent, and hypotenuse sides relative to an acute angle.
Understand the foundational role of these ratios in trigonometry.
sections.renderer_reasoning: Manim is ideal for illustrating right-angled triangles, labeling sides, and presenting the definitions of sine, cosine, and tangent with formulas.

sections.title: Understanding Reciprocal Trigonometric Ratios
learning_goals: Define cosecant, secant, and cotangent as reciprocals of the primary ratios.
Relate csc, sec, and cot to sin, cos, and tan respectively.
Recognize when to use reciprocal ratios in calculations.

sections.title: Calculating All Ratios from a Given Tangent
learning_goals: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find missing side lengths in a right triangle.

sections.title: Proving Angle Equality Using Sine Ratios
learning_goals: Understand how equal sine ratios imply equal angles in specific contexts.

Utilize the Pythagorean theorem in proofs involving trigonometric ratios.

sections.title: Evaluating Trigonometric Square Identities
learning_goals: Evaluate expressions involving squared trigonometric ratios.
Recognize and apply the fundamental Pythagorean identity (sin²θ + cos²θ = 1).
Simplify complex trigonometric expressions using identities.
